summary: RIFT can advertise key/value pairs in Key-Value Topology Information Elements. This Standards Track document specifies behavior for the Key Types (Well-Known, Organizationally Unique Identifier, and Experimental) and a method to structure the values. It also defines a Well-Known Key Sub-Type.

eli5.summary: Routers pass notes labeled with a title and a message. This sets the rules on how to write the labels and organize the messages.
